description.zh:
偏差检测ID。  
您可以调用[DetectStackDrift](~~610877~~)获取偏差检测ID。
description.en:
The ID of the drift detection operation.

You can call the [ListStackResourceDrifts](~~155098~~) operation to obtain the ID of the drift detection operation.

description.zh:
偏差检测关联的资源栈所属的地域ID。  
您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~131035~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en:
The region ID of the stack to be detected for drift.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，为您查询杭州地域偏差检测ID为`a7044f0d-6f2e-4128-a307-4524ef88****`的偏差检测操作的状态。
descriptions.en: In this topic, the status of a drift detection operation whose ID is `a7044f0d-6f2e-4128-a307-4524ef88****` is queried. The operation is performed in the China (Hangzhou) region.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros get-stack-drift-detection-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --drift-detection-id a7044f0d-6f2e-4128-a307-4524ef880000 --region cn-hangzhou
